readiness.hed: A Frost Advisory is up tonight through 9 a.m. Sunday, with a sunny, breezy Saturday afternoon near 63 and a low near 36.
readiness.insight: The National Weather Service posted a Frost Advisory Saturday afternoon for Spotsylvania and surrounding counties, running from midnight through 9 a.m. Sunday. Temperatures of 33 to 36 degrees are expected to form frost that could harm or kill uncovered sensitive outdoor plants. The Fredericksburg forecast, updated Saturday afternoon, has a sunny, breezy rest of the day with a high near 63 and northwest wind around 14 mph gusting to 22. Tonight is clear with patchy frost after midnight and a low around 36. Sunday is sunny with a high near 65 after patchy frost clears by 9 a.m., and Monday stays sunny with a high near 66.
actions: Cover or bring in sensitive plants before dark — the advisory runs midnight to 9 a.m. Sunday.
Grab a jacket for anything outside after dark tonight; wind gusts to 22 mph will make it feel colder.
No other watches or warnings are posted for the Fredericksburg point this afternoon.
